header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. The perusal of the
record shows that this petition was filed in the year 2024 and was lastly fixed on
22.01.2025. Thereafter, no efforts were made by the petitioner or his counsel to pursue
body: this petition, which reflects that he is not interested in the same. Under these circumstances, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution. JUDGE JUDGE Salik
